messages:
evan: quick follow-up from the pm 1942: identifying recurring patterns + an owner rotation for short-term fixes. putting a compact action set here. :spiral_note_pad:
tess: i'll own the reconnect/backoff changes for the next sprint. plan: resume token + bounded in-memory buffer (128 tokens). retries=3 with jittered backoff. due: 2026-04-14.
oliver: i'll take observability: partial-response ratio, p95 stream latency, and a rolling-24h error-rate heatmap. draft prom rule: `sum(increase(chat_stream_partial_total[15m])) / sum(increase(chat_stream_request_total[15m])) > 0.05`. will add region labels and runbook link. due: 2026-04-11.
priya: infra ask: enable jemalloc on the hot-service canary and schedule a GC-tuning pass. also create a temporary model-fallback toggle for immediate mitigation.
infra-bot: /action created: jemalloc-canary (owner: infra-canary) check-in:6h status: open
infra-bot: /action created: model-fallback-toggle (owner: infra-release) interval:60s ttl:1h
tess: client notes: expose onResume callback, attempt linear backoff up to 6s, and provide an explicit reconnect status code. i'll add SDK snippets for node/python.
ev an (typo), corrected: evan: also proposal: 2-week owner rotation for incident follow-ups so ownership doesn't bottleneck. will add to ops rotation calendar.
oliver: alert should include an automated remediation hint: "if firing > threshold, flip fallback route -> notify on-call". will wire that into the runbook.
evan: action summary (ISO): tess reconnect due 2026-04-14, oliver observability due 2026-04-11, infra jemalloc+toggle due 2026-04-10. please update the incident tracker one-line per task when status changes (todo/in-progress/done). i'll run a closure sweep in 7 days. :thumbsup:
